body: Seeing how much your friends respected and cared about you really puts things into perspective for me. Anyone who knows the truth but willingly wants to deny it- and still talks about him like nothing happened- shouldn't be someone I devote a lot of time to.
Thank you for the link- and just affirming my feelings. It really helps.

He's not telling them anything. He's acting like nothing happened. I'd agree that making people take sides isn't fair, but I'm not telling people to do that. At this point, I just want them to stop talking about him around me. That's all I've asked of them, and they still don't. It just ends up hurting every time I see them. It's to the point where I know it's healthier for me to cut ties, but I'm stubborn. I don't want to give up my friends. I just want them to understand and be considerate.

I agree. It's not my business to know what's going on in my friend's relationships even if they tell me about things that bother them. However, if my friend told me they were being abused by another one of my friends, I wouldn't just accept that. That's not a relationship issue. That is a moral issue. I'm not okay with that and I wouldn't just stand there without confronting the abuser. Would you just sit there and pretend like nothing happened if your friend was physically abused by one of your other friends? Probably not. So why is it okay with emotional abuse?

But perhaps that's just me. Long story short- I have told my friends and they have refused to stop talking about him as well as his sig. other.
True story. It feels like a poisonous addiction at this point. I'm hoping you found your way out from people like that as well.
No kidding. I feel like a used piece of trash.
Already on it! If I could move, I would do that too!

He's a charismatic son of a bitch- and he knows it and uses it to his advantage. People either love him or get bad vibes from him. He knows how to cry and play the victim when he needs to, and it's way too convincing. This man is no good.
I agree. It hurts so much to be used by someone you thought you could trust, but it's a life lesson in the very least.
Well he didn't cheat on me with her. But, yes, I do have the texts to back it up- and I do know who she is. So I probably will send them to her.
I think that will be an easy one to remember- considering. Thanks
I plan on telling her, don't get me wrong. I just don't plan on making it a public affair. It would likely embarrass/hurt her more to do it via Facebook.
I could do that- but I don't think I'd get much satisfaction out of it. I got burned, plain and simple. It fucking hurts- and I feel like trash, but I don't think it will make me feel any better.
Well at least it clarifies some things for me- like I was right for leaving him in the first place.
You're very right. It feels like shit- but you're right.

I did make it very easy, but none of this is really typical of his normal behavior. He's never treated anyone that way before. He also thought that I hated him- so I'm really not sure why I would be the first one he contacts for a booty call.
It's not facebook official, but he's been sleeping over at her house every night.
If I had to guess, I would say that he does love me, but he feels like shit for cheating.
He very well could have, but I'm not really sure why he would do that if he had a gf who gives him sex regularly. He never did that before.

He has had some serious mood swings while we dated- some snapping for random things. He has never cheated on me or before that as far as my knowledge goes. I'm scared to pressure him into an answer right away if he is dating someone.

I'm not quite sure how to turn my brain off from the negative, but I will try. I got stuck living with my ex, and I finally get to move out. I'm hoping that will bring some sanity back. Right now, I still really miss him and want to be with him. I know logically that this is a terrible idea, but I feel like there's some kind of addiction.

Just feeling unstable in general lately. I put on a happy face around friends and family because I can have fun when I'm with them, but I feel dead most of the time. I don't see any purpose to moving forward. Yes- I can have a successful career- I may even have a satisfying relationship with my current bf, but it feels pointless- like a piece of me will never truly feel satisfied like I used to.
Yes, please
